messages.subject: Does categorical variable slow down the process?
parts:
Hi

I have run a few CFA models using lavaan. It takes about 10-15 minutes to run my model without categorical variables. I have 159 variables (approximately 18 latent variables) and 1640 observations. 

However, when I add categorical variables, the execution time increases to hours. Actually, it runs more than 10 hours.

Would you please help me with this?

Thank you.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Does categorical variable slow down the process?
parts:
On 10/10/2015 10:13 PM, cho...@gmail.com wrote:
> I have run a few CFA models using lavaan. It takes about 10-15 minutes
> to run my model without categorical variables. I have 159 variables
> (approximately 18 latent variables) and 1640 observations.

In the categorical case, this means we need to estimate 159*158/2 =
12561 polychoric (or tetrachoric) correlations. And if we assume binary
data, another 159 thresholds. Then, we need to estimate the asymptotic
variance matrix of these 12561 + 159 = 12720 sample statistics,
resulting in a 12720 x 12720 weight matrix...

All of that with 1640 observations. I would say you have a rather small
sample for this size of model.

> However, when I add categorical variables, the execution time increases
> to hours. Actually, it runs more than 10 hours.

I am surprised it runs at all. 10 hours is not so bad. I have models
that run for many, many days.
> Would you please help me with this?
